Name: Random Faction (Will not count toward the gold limit)
War Tribes
Strengths: Unmatched in melee power and mass.
Weaknesses: Relies on brute force of melee infantry.

Name: Central Kingdoms
Strengths: Excellent elite heavy infantry and cavalry.
Weaknesses: Mediocre early units. Lacks elite ranged units.
Description: Chivalry and Romance. The human feudal communities of the Central Kingdoms were among the most traditional. They believed in absolute chivalry and tolerate change to a certain degree. The core structure of this society was as follows: humans were the worldly authorities of the civilised world, and housekins were the loyal workforce of the community.

Name: Homeward Hordes
Strengths: Can inflict myriad plagues and poison.
Weaknesses: High upkeep and low reserve number.
Description: Humanity or Transcension. There are many civilisations that fell to ruin and were forgotten by history. These ancient people lost their homes and place in the world. With necromancy magic, the dead rose once more to reclaim what was once theirs. The livings became their new enemies.

Name: New World Settlers
Weaknesses: No native troops or leaders of its own.

Name: Oasis Commonwealth
Weaknesses: Relies on magical powers to compete in late period.

Name: Doll Families
Description: Unyielding and Unchanging. The Doll Families were made up of ancient artificial beings long forgotten; they existed even longer than the undead. Scholars hypothesise that these dolls were golem servants created by a long-lost civilisation. Hostile to all living beings, these dolls refused most integration with other cultures.

Name: Highland Clans
Weaknesses: Focus on offence rather than defence.

Name: Cactus Realms
Description: Zealous and Resourceful. The Cactus Realms were a highly ritualistic and religious society made up of goblins and jungle lizards. Everyone lived for the higher cause of their gods. Even in the face of death, they must perform their last worship obligation. Although the nobility and clergy were distinctly separated in social class and role, most important political and civic conducts were performed at the pyramid temples.

Name: Small People
Description: Happiness or Survival. The Small People are, as the name implies, a society made up mostly of creatures of small stature within the verts around the central continent. They are friendly to all small and other vert beings. Many believe them to be savage, capable of only low-level civilisation at best. The wises, however, never underestimate what they are capable of.

Name: Neutral
Description: Free and Fun. Those with a free spirit do not belong to a rooted society of their birthplace. They will travel the world and perhaps join any faction they visit.
